PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= python3 - <<'PY'
import gc, json, pathlib, signal, tempfile, weakref
from orze.engine.orchestrator import Orze
from orze.engine import cpu_phase
saved={sig:signal.getsignal(sig) for sig in (signal.SIGINT,signal.SIGTERM)}
first=second=None
try:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="orze-e-nested-hooks-") as temp:
        def configuration(name):
            scope=pathlib.Path(temp)/name
            return {
                "execution":{"version":1,"resource":"cpu","slots":1,"wall_budget_seconds":5},
                "results_dir":str(scope/"results"),"ideas_file":str(scope/"ideas.md"),
                "idea_lake_db":str(scope/"lake.db"),"min_disk_gb":0,
                "action_domain":{"version":1,"kind":"command","config":{}},
                "action_policy":{"version":1,"kind":"queue","idle":"wait","wait_seconds":.05}}
        first=Orze([],configuration("first"),once=True)
        second=Orze([],configuration("second"),once=True)
        first_ref,second_ref=weakref.ref(first),weakref.ref(second)
        cpu_phase.close(first)
        protected_second=all(getattr(signal.getsignal(sig),"__self__",None) is second for sig in saved)
        cpu_phase.close(second)
        result={
            "first_closed":first._cpu_closed,"second_closed":second._cpu_closed,
            "first_interfaces_released":first._cpu_interfaces is None,
            "second_interfaces_released":second._cpu_interfaces is None,
            "newer_handler_was_protected":protected_second,
            "closed_first_reinstalled":all(getattr(signal.getsignal(sig),"__self__",None) is first for sig in saved),
            "handlers_restored_original":all(signal.getsignal(sig) is old for sig,old in saved.items()),
            "first_actions":len(first._cpu_handles),"second_actions":len(second._cpu_handles)}
        first=second=None
        gc.collect()
        result.update(first_retained=first_ref() is not None,second_retained=second_ref() is not None)
        print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
        assert first_ref() is None, "successful older invocation is re-rooted by restoring its stale handler"
finally:
    for sig,handler in saved.items():
        signal.signal(sig,handler)
    for engine in (first,second):
        if engine is not None:
            cpu_phase.close(engine)
PY
